name: Solve chemical equations and thermodynamics problems
description: Users asked to balance, write, or verify chemical equations and reaction mechanisms, as well as to calculate thermodynamic properties, equilibrium constants, and electrochemical potentials. They also requested identification of reaction products, isomers, and structural features for various organic and inorganic compounds.
